stemMarkdown: What best describes the tone of the author when discussing Mill's relationship with Mrs. Taylor?
solutionMarkdown: The author adopts a slightly skeptical yet respectful tone when discussing John Stuart Mill's relationship with Mrs. Taylor, as evidenced by mentioning both positive influence (her counsel) and the controversies around their relationship ('considerable trouble').
